notes: ORDER BY and LIMIT only reorder and truncate rows; neither can introduce a NULL, so the answer is the plain base-table answer -- `text` NOT NULL, `owner_id` nullable. It is a regression case (sqlx #4147) because adding a sort/limit changes the plan shape: the scan is wrapped in a Limit over a Sort node, and an engine that reads attribution off the top plan node instead of chasing it down to the scan loses the NOT NULL on `text`. The `ORDER BY id` also references a column that is not in the select list, which is a second way to confuse output-column mapping.
